track: Instrument authenticated original FFT slot0 SPIR-V directly for private keyed image-fetch readback

A direct SPIR-V-only storage-buffer tracer can record key/occurrence/coordinates/value bits without HLSL conversion, preserving FFT output, enabling future matched numerical comparison against translated keyed candidate trace.
approach: Add bounded fail-closed original-source-only SPIR-V instrumentation and source-free adversarial tests, plus private Vulkan original-pipeline host (set0 binding3) using exact original pin. Do not expose any original SPIR-V/trace bytes or change game shader; if original CFG/function ownership differs or SPIRV-val fails, classify safe blocker before actual readback. No Unity heavy build or work on other clients.
